title: Understanding AI Trustworthiness: A Scoping Review of AIES & FAccT Articles
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. This paper is a scoping review and does not introduce or evaluate a specific benchmark related to religion or faith.
findings: The paper makes a brief mention that the study of AI trustworthiness within the humanities includes inquiries into religious perspectives as part of broader cultural and ethical considerations.
